title: Forbidden City: No Same-Day Tickets, Book 7 Days Ahead | China Travel Expert
description:
The Forbidden City sells no same-day tickets. Booking opens exactly 7 days ahead, at 20:00 Beijing time — and on peak dates the slots can disappear within minutes.

It's a real-name system: you book and enter with the same passport, one admission per ID per day. The palace is closed on Mondays (except public holidays). Entry is ¥60 in peak season (Apr 1–Oct 31) and drops to ¥40 from Nov 1. Set an alarm for 20:00, seven days before you want to go, and log in a minute early.

🧭 Expert Tip: tickets drop at 20:00 Beijing time exactly 7 days out — log in a minute before the clock with your passport details ready.

故宫不卖当日票：开放前 7 天晚上 20:00 实名放票，热门日期几分钟就抢光，周一闭馆（节假日除外）。
